brief.t: CRM is back. The developer fixed the lockout, but every password was reset. Log in as sam with P L L twenty twenty five exclamation point, and it will force you to set a new one. Do that first thing so the team can follow. The developer still owes us a new API key and a permanent storage fix or this happens again on the next restart.

Ashley Aurora at Earth and Ash is the fire today. Three unanswered follow ups, she says Miron glass was included in the agreed quote and calls the new bottle estimate a contract change, and she likely missed a scheduled call with you. She is waiting on you personally. Call her this morning before this becomes a lost client or worse.

A hot new lead at three one two, nine hundred, fourteen seventy nine asked how many units and how much, and said they would like to start soon. Nobody has answered. That is money sitting in WhatsApp. Reply or tell me the numbers and I will.
Hard deadlines today: Gusto payroll must be run by seven P M Eastern, and you have the Ako Stark call at ten A M.

Elmar Nasibov got his quote but is irritated it came late, and there is an M O Q conflict — he insists on two hundred fifty units, quote says five hundred per SKU. Decide the M O Q line and I will smooth it over. Signature is pending.

Ronald has been silent since July eighth. Aran Beauty scents, Maqui status, and Victor's ingredient costs are all stuck on him, and he says the lab cannot batch Aran samples without a brief in the CRM. Also good news: Drake paid the twenty eight hundred dollar R and D invoice.

Still open on your desk: landlord counter offer of two extra months free base rent plus half of December, Tyler Murray's N D A third chase, Jose at Ephix wants a go ahead, Laura's STRUCK box art and revised scope need your signature, and the website needs your Shopify login so I can fix the two broken lead forms.

Reply to the three one two hot lead, or hand me pricing and I will
Before seven P M: run Gusto payroll. Then landlord counter offer decision

kb.a: The CRM lockout is fixed as of July fifteenth. Root cause was the developer's deploy restoring a stale user table. All passwords were reset to the temporary P L L twenty twenty five exclamation point, username sam works, and the system forces a new password on first login. Still outstanding from the developer: re-provision the agent API key, mount permanent storage so this cannot recur, and close a security hole where the SQL endpoint accepts arbitrary queries.

Ashley Aurora of Earth and Ash has sent three or more unanswered follow ups. She says Miron glass was included in the agreed quote and considers the new bottles and lids estimate a contract alteration. She likely missed a scheduled call and is waiting on Sam personally. Highest risk client conversation today.

A new WhatsApp lead at three one two, nine hundred, one four seven nine asked how many units are needed and how much, and said they would like to start soon. Unanswered. Needs a same day reply with M O Q and pricing direction.

Elmar Nasibov received his three product quote by WhatsApp on July fifteenth but is irritated it came late. Open conflict: he insists on two hundred fifty units minimum, the quote says five hundred per SKU. Draft unit prices at batch five hundred, ingredients only: mist seven sixty nine, peptide cream five seventy four, serum five seventy three — packaging and labor not yet included. Signature pending Sam's M O Q decision.
Gusto payroll must be submitted by seven P M Eastern today, Thursday July sixteenth, for the team to be paid on time.
Ako Stark booked a Calendly meeting with Sam for ten A M Eastern today, Thursday July sixteenth.
Landlord Richard Kerwin sent a counter offer: two extra months of free base rent plus fifty percent off December. Awaiting Sam's decision on the new facility lease.

Ronald has not replied in team chat since July eighth. Stuck on him: Aran Beauty scent samples, Maqui formula revision overdue since June nineteenth, and Victor Armendarez ingredient costs. He said the lab cannot batch Aran samples without a brief or formulation in the CRM.

Victor Armendarez, eighty seven percent close, Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel, two thousand units each, seventy five percent margin, N D A signed. Quote overdue since July tenth, still blocked on Ronald's raw ingredient costs. No quote exists in the CRM yet.
Drake at True Revival paid the twenty eight hundred dollar R and D invoice. The corrected agreement still needs to be emailed to Drake and to Laura — Sam owes Drake's email address.
Tyler Murray at Calder Capital is on his third chase of the unsigned N D A. Sam needs to decide: sign or decline.
Jose Zuniga at Ephix flagged fees and expenses and wants Sam's go ahead to proceed. Waiting on Sam.

Laura sent STRUCK box art and the revised project scope, high importance, awaiting Sam's signature. Laura also reported three CRM bugs on July thirteenth that the developer has not answered: task assign dropdown broken, pipeline assign dropdown missing, and a notes date bug.

Website audit found two lead leaks. The homepage quote form sends nothing at all, and the Contact Us form delivers to the outside agency's inbox, not to Sam. The buy flow for samples works fine. Fix needs Sam to log into Shopify admin once in the agent's browser. Paid ads stay on hold until the forms are fixed.

A Sales Pipeline view is now visible in the CRM and the dashboard shows ten open deals worth about one point three four million, with six closed won at about a hundred twenty nine thousand. Formal verification of the Option A build is still pending because the developer never sent ready for verification.

Aidan is overdue on the Atlas quote to Kenna, Pure Good and Terra Lotus pricing from July eighth, and the Delphos quote. His Nasibov pricing task is actually done, the quote went out July fifteenth, the task just needs closing.
Uberto asked for the production schedule. His labels are done at the end of July and product must be in Florida by August twentieth.
Kristina sent the Petit Nuage brief on WhatsApp. Needs review and a task assignment.
HALENE sent their brief and ship to address on WhatsApp. Needs review and next step.
Ethnic Gals messaged tried calling on WhatsApp. Needs a callback.

Ben Kar of Tavro, ninety percent close, thirty thousand units of custom tallow and argan oil skincare. Proposal still never sent and the task is urgent and overdue from July eighth. Agent drafts, Sam reviews, then it goes out once.
Tiffany flew out on safari after Wednesday. No unread messages from her. James still owes the quote conversation when she resurfaces.

Data problem in the CRM: all twenty five quotes carry zero dollars for packaging, labor, and overhead because no rates exist in the system. Every quote so far is ingredients only, which understates true cost. Rates need to be set before quoting is trustworthy.
